items.question: 末日轮50ETF购期权成交量超过8万手的合约
items.sql: SELECT contract_name, remain_days, volume FROM etf_option_data WHERE contract_name LIKE '%购%' AND remain_days <= 2 AND volume > 80000 ORDER BY volume DESC;

items.question: 末日轮50ETF沽期权成交量超过5万手的合约
items.sql: SELECT contract_name, remain_days, volume FROM etf_option_data WHERE contract_name LIKE '%沽%' AND remain_days <= 2 AND volume > 50000 ORDER BY volume DESC;

items.question: 本周到期50ETF购期权涨跌幅超过10%的合约
items.sql: SELECT contract_name, remain_days, price_change_rate FROM etf_option_data WHERE contract_name LIKE '%购%' AND remain_days <= 3 AND price_change_rate > 10 ORDER BY price_change_rate DESC;

items.question: 本周到期50ETF沽期权跌幅超过8%的合约
items.sql: SELECT contract_name, remain_days, price_change_rate FROM etf_option_data WHERE contract_name LIKE '%沽%' AND remain_days <= 3 AND price_change_rate < -8 ORDER BY price_change_rate ASC;

items.question: 本周到期50ETF购期权成交量最大的合约
items.sql: SELECT * FROM etf_option_data WHERE contract_name LIKE '%购%' AND remain_days <= 3 ORDER BY volume DESC LIMIT 1;

items.question: 本周到期50ETF沽期权成交量最大的合约
items.sql: SELECT * FROM etf_option_data WHERE contract_name LIKE '%沽%' AND remain_days <= 3 ORDER BY volume DESC LIMIT 1;

items.question: 近10天到期50ETF购期权涨跌幅最高的合约

items.question: 近10天到期50ETF沽期权涨跌幅最低的合约
items.sql: SELECT * FROM etf_option_data WHERE contract_name LIKE '%沽%' AND remain_days <= 10 ORDER BY price_change_rate ASC LIMIT 1;

items.question: 本月到期50ETF购期权持仓量超过20万的合约
